en: Adductors: knees in / stability
tw: 內收肌群：膝蓋內收／穩定

en: A butter presses the nose (or tail) into the snow as a pivot while the rest of the board lifts off, so friction is low and it can spin. Soft boards with less camber make it easier.
tw: Butter 是把板頭（或板尾）壓在雪面當支點，其餘部分離雪，所以摩擦小、轉得動。軟板和 camber 少的板比較容易做。

en: Butter 360
tw: Butter 轉 360

en: The CoM crosses over the board from the old turn's inside to the new turn's inside; the board flips under the CoM — you don't push the board.
tw: 重心從舊彎內側越過板子上方，到新彎內側；是板子在重心下方翻過去，不是人去推板。

en: The CoM travels from near the snow on one side, over the board, to near the snow on the other side; extend first, then drop in — the board flips underneath you.
tw: 重心從貼近雪面的一側，越過板子上方到另一側貼雪；身體要先伸展再倒下去，板子在身體下方翻過去。

en: Edge vs slope
tw: 立刃 vs 坡度

en: The closer the edge angle is to the slope angle, the more 'level' the base sits against gravity → more friction → you stop; a small edge angle lets you slide. No speed setting needed.
tw: 立刃越接近坡度，板底對地心引力越「平」→ 摩擦越大 → 停下；立刃小就會滑。不需要設定速度。

en: Edge angle eases off as the body 'springs' back up from the snow, ready for the next crossover.
tw: 立刃慢慢減少，身體從雪面「彈」回來，準備下一次越過。

en: As the edge angle approaches the slope angle the board stops. Heel slip: lift your toes (tibialis anterior); toe slip: push your knees forward (calves).
tw: 立刃接近坡度時板子就會停。後刃推坡：勾起腳趾（脛前肌）；前刃推坡：膝蓋往前推（小腿肌）。

en: Flatten the edge a little and the nose turns naturally toward the fall line.
tw: 立刃稍微放平，板頭自然轉向滾落線。

en: With the edge angle below the slope angle, the board slides down. Look ahead, weight even, knees slightly bent.
tw: 立刃小於坡度時，板子就會往下滑。眼睛看前方，雙腳平均，膝蓋保持微彎。

en: Edge angle
tw: 立刃角度

en: Erector spinae: supports the upper body on toeside
tw: 豎脊肌：前刃時撐住上半身

en: Garlands are the step before linked turns: you only practise the top half (release and drop) and bottom half (re-edge and climb) of a turn, with no edge change.
tw: Garland 是連續轉彎前的一步：只練轉彎的上半（放刃下滑）和下半（入刃回升），不用換刃。

en: Gastroc/Soleus: press the toes down on toeside
tw: 小腿肌：前刃時把腳趾往下壓

en: Glute max: keeps the hips from pushing back on toeside
tw: 臀大肌：前刃時讓髖部不要往後頂

en: Glute med: stabilises the pelvis
tw: 臀中肌：穩定骨盆

en: Goofy (right foot forward)
tw: Goofy（右腳在前）

en: Hamstrings: co-contract to protect the knee
tw: 膕旁肌：協同收縮保護膝蓋

en: Heel slip: lift your toes to stop, lower them to slide; repeat 5 times, then try a toe slip.
tw: 後刃推坡：勾起腳趾停、放低腳趾滑，重複 5 次；之後再試前刃推坡。

en: An ollie uses the flex of the tail (or nose): the preload bends the board to store energy, the pop releases it, then you tuck your legs so the board rises with you.
tw: 豚跳（Ollie）是利用板尾（或板頭）的彈性：預壓讓板子彎曲儲能，pop 時釋放，再收腳讓板子跟著身體起來。

en: Quadriceps: hold the flexed-knee stance, heaviest on heelside
tw: 股四頭肌：撐住屈膝姿勢，後刃特別吃重

en: On an R8 board you need about 30 km/h to get down to 70°; drag the speed in Spec and watch the lean change.
tw: R8 的板大約要 30 km/h 才倒得到 70°；到「規格設定」拉速度，看看傾倒角度怎麼變。

en: Rectus abd.: stops you falling back on heelside
tw: 腹直肌：後刃時防止往後倒

en: Switch
tw: 反腳 Switch

en: Switch: your usual back foot becomes the front foot. The muscle and fore/aft pressure pattern is the same as normal but mirrored: your usual back foot's tibialis anterior and calf now do the front-foot job, so switch usually feels clumsy. A duck stance (+15/−6) becomes +6/−15 in switch; the front foot angle is smaller, so the board responds a little slower.
tw: 反腳（Switch）：用平常的後腳當前腳。肌肉和前後腳壓力的模式跟正腳一樣，只是鏡像：平常後腳的脛前肌、小腿肌要做前腳的工作，所以反腳通常會覺得笨拙。八字站姿（+15/−6）反腳時變成 +6/−15，前腳角度變小，所以板子反應會慢一點。

en: Tibialis ant.: lifts the toes on heelside
tw: 脛前肌：後刃時勾起腳趾

tw: 前刃側

en: On toeside the front hand reaches to the snow and only brushes it — it doesn't hold you up.
tw: 前刃時前手伸向雪面，只是輕輕掃過，不是撐住身體。

tw: 前刃低姿態刻滑

en: Toeside vs heelside:
tw: 前刃和後刃的差別：

en: On toeside the calves press the toes; jump to heelside to compare — the tibialis anterior takes over.
tw: 前刃靠小腿肌壓腳趾；跳到後刃比較，脛前肌會變成主力。

en: Toeside bending at the waist: the butt sticks out and the CoM leaves the edge, so you slip. Heelside 'toilet sit': the butt sits behind the board and you fall back. Flex your knees and ankles instead of your waist.
tw: 前刃彎腰：屁股往外翹，重心離開刃，容易打滑。後刃「坐馬桶」：屁股坐到板子後面，容易往後坐倒。應該用屈膝、屈腳踝來代替彎腰。

en: Should the hips push back on toeside?
tw: 前刃時髖部應該往後頂嗎？

en: Long body on toeside
tw: 前刃身體拉長

en: Toeside: press the toes
tw: 前刃：壓腳趾

en: Toeside: knees into the turn
tw: 前刃：膝蓋入彎

en: Toeside mainly uses the calves to press the toes down and the glutes to keep the hips from pushing back; heelside mainly uses the tibialis anterior to lift the toes, with the quads and abs holding the 'seated' position. That's why many people's thighs and abs tire faster on heelside.
tw: 前刃主要靠小腿肌壓低腳趾、臀大肌讓髖部不要往後推；後刃主要靠脛前肌勾起腳趾、股四頭肌和腹肌撐住「坐」的姿勢。所以很多人後刃大腿和腹肌特別累。

tw: 一條雪道做 3–4 個 garland 再停，後刃和前刃兩邊都要練。

en: Practise in place on flat ground first, then slowly on a gentle slope; land on both feet at the same time.
tw: 先在平地原地練，再到緩坡慢速做；落地時雙腳要同時著地。

tw: 先在平地練 nose press 站穩 3 秒，再加 180，最後才試 360。

en: Flatten the board first (weight even, knees slightly bent), then slowly move your weight onto the new edge. Look where you want to go.
tw: 先把板子放平（雙腳平均、膝蓋微彎），再慢慢把重心移到新的刃。眼睛看要去的方向。

en: No. Your weight is still over the edge; the hand only touches lightly.

en: On a gentle slope do a carved traverse: use one edge across the run, then look back to see if it left a single thin line.
tw: 在緩坡做刻滑橫越：只用一邊刃橫過雪道，再回頭看雪上是不是一條細線。

en: The board pivots 360 on the nose on the snow; the upper body leads.
tw: 板子以板頭為支點在雪面磨轉 360，上半身帶頭。

en: Pressure gradually moves to the back foot, use the skid angle to control speed, get ready to extend and change edges.
tw: 壓力慢慢移到後腳，用搓雪角度控速，準備伸展換刃。

en: Pressure moves toward the back foot and the edge angle eases off, ready to release; don't release too early or the tail will wash out.

en: Back foot / side
tw: 後腳／後側

en: What do you need most to get really low?
tw: 想倒得低，最需要什麼？

en: To stop, do you increase or decrease the edge angle?
tw: 想停下，立刃要加大還是減小？

en: How do you turn from a traverse toward the fall line?
tw: 想從斜滑降轉向滾落線，要怎麼做？

en: Hand on snow
tw: 手掃雪

en: Is the hand on the snow there to hold you up?
tw: 手掃雪是用來撐住身體的嗎？

en: Drag to rotate 360°, pinch to zoom · one cycle = one toeside + one heelside turn · tap a row in the muscle table to isolate it
tw: 拖曳 360° 旋轉、雙指縮放・一個循環 = 一個前刃＋一個後刃・點肌肉表任一列可單獨查看

en: Control comes from the ankles and knees; keep the upper body and hands still.
tw: 控制靠腳踝和膝蓋，上半身和手保持穩定。

en: Control: hold the edge
tw: 控制：維持立刃

en: Pick a wide, well-groomed run, start with heelside and increase the lean gradually; protect your knees and wrists.
tw: 選壓雪好的寬雪道，先練後刃，逐步加大傾倒；記得保護膝蓋和手腕。

en: CoM crossover at the edge change
tw: 換刃重心越過

en: Extend before the edge change to unweight; flatten the board quickly, then move to the other edge.
tw: 換刃前伸展身體減壓，板子很快放平，再換到另一邊刃。

en: Flatten the board before changing edges, then roll onto the other edge.
tw: 換刃前先把板子放平，再換到另一邊刃。

en: After the edge change flex gradually to load; the front foot guides the nose into the turn; keep the upper body quiet, don't rotate.
tw: 換刃後慢慢屈曲加壓，前腳引導板頭入彎；上半身保持穩定，不要帶轉。

en: Right after the edge change the body drops into the turn and the nose bites first; GRF quickly rises to about 2–3× body weight.
tw: 換刃後身體立刻往彎內倒，板頭先咬雪；地面反作用力會很快升到大約 2–3 倍體重。

en: Extend to unweight at the edge change, flex to load in the turn.
tw: 換刃時伸展減壓，入彎就屈曲加壓。

en: Flat edge change
tw: 換刃要放平

en: Edge change (extend to unweight)
tw: 換刃（伸展減壓）

en: Edge change (flatten the board)
tw: 換刃（板子放平）

en: Edge change: big CoM crossover
tw: 換刃：重心大幅越過

en: Pivot spin
tw: 支點旋轉

en: Release and drop, re-edge and climb — the step before linked turns.
tw: 放刃下滑、入刃回升，是連續轉彎前的一步。

en: When releasing to drop, a bit more front-foot pressure steers the nose down — watch the foot map.
tw: 放刃下滑時前腳壓力多一點帶板頭往下，看腳掌圖。

en: Flatten the edge slightly and press lightly with the front foot.
tw: 立刃稍微放平，前腳輕輕加壓。

en: Flatten the edge slightly and the nose turns toward the fall line — like the start of half a turn.
tw: 立刃稍微放平，板頭轉向滾落線下滑，像半個彎的開頭。

en: Flatten out
tw: 放回平板

en: Tip into the turn early; the front foot adds edge first, so you're on edge before GRF builds.
tw: 早點傾倒入彎，前腳先加立刃，在地面反作用力變大之前就已經入刃。

en: Tip early, let the board turn itself, leave a single thin line in the snow.
tw: 早點傾倒，讓板子自己轉，雪上只留一條細線。

en: Look where you're going (over the nose), shoulders roughly parallel to the board; don't look at your feet.
tw: 看前進的方向（板頭），肩膀大致與板子平行；不要看腳。

en: Look where you want to go; head and shoulders lead the body.
tw: 看要去的方向，頭和肩膀帶動身體。

en: Look ahead (downhill), not at the board.
tw: 看前方（下坡方向），不要看板子。

en: Look where you're going, front foot leads, back foot follows.
tw: 看要去哪裡，前腳帶，後腳跟。

en: Board R = sidecut radius. When carving, turn radius ≈ R × cos(edge angle) and lean angle comes from tan θ = v² / (g·r). On a snowboard the edge angle is about equal to body lean, so the carving balance condition simplifies to sin θ ≈ v² / (g·R). Bindings at +15° / −6° (duck), stance width ≈ height × 0.31. Recommended ranges are rules of thumb.
tw: 板子 R = 側切半徑。刻滑時轉彎半徑 ≈ R × cos(立刃角度)，傾倒角由 tan θ = v² / (g·r) 計算。單板的立刃差不多等於身體傾倒，所以刻滑的平衡條件可以簡化成 sin θ ≈ v² / (g·R)。固定器角度用 +15° / −6°（八字站姿），站距 ≈ 身高 × 0.31。建議範圍是一般經驗值。

en: Edge track
tw: 刃痕

en: The board points further into the turn than its path — that's a skid, used to control speed.
tw: 板子方向比行進路線更往彎內，就是搓雪，用來控速。

en: Board pressure: ${bpLabel(cm/Lb)}・Front ${Math.round(wF*100)}%
tw: 板子壓力：${bpLabel(cm/Lb)}・前腳 ${Math.round(wF*100)}%

en: Board pressure: airborne
tw: 板子壓力：離地

en: Turn the board a bit more across and it skids to slow down; weight drifts back to centre, ready to change edges.
tw: 板子再打橫一點就會搓雪減速，重心慢慢回到雙腳中間，準備換刃。

en: Board flat, ready.
tw: 板子放平，準備。

en: Board heading ${Math.abs(p.psi/D).toFixed(0)}° (0° = fall line)・Edge ${Math.abs(p.edge/D).toFixed(0)}°
tw: 板子方向 ${Math.abs(p.psi/D).toFixed(0)}°（0° = 滾落線）・立刃 ${Math.abs(p.edge/D).toFixed(0)}°

en: Board height ${Math.round((p.lift||0)*100)} cm・Board pitch ${Math.abs((p.pitch||0)/D).toFixed(0)}°
tw: 板子離雪 ${Math.round((p.lift||0)*100)} cm・板子角度 ${Math.abs((p.pitch||0)/D).toFixed(0)}°

en: No pressure on the nose: slow initiation, the nose floats, so you end up twisting the upper body to turn. The back-leg quads get overloaded and you skid or catch an edge.
tw: 板頭沒有壓力，入彎慢、板頭會飄，結果要用上半身扭才轉得過去。後腳股四頭肌負荷爆表，容易打滑或吃刃。

en: Euro carve
tw: 低姿態刻滑

en: Euro carve (extreme low carve)
tw: 低姿態刻滑（Euro carve）

en: Before each turn, turn your head toward the next direction first, then press the front foot lightly.
tw: 每個彎之前先轉頭看下一個方向，再輕輕壓前腳。

en: Say 'up, press' for every turn; try a few turns with your hands on your knees to feel the lower body steering.
tw: 每個彎喊「起、壓」；試著把手放在膝蓋上做幾個彎，感覺下半身帶轉。

en: Slide
tw: 下滑

en: Slide: reduce the edge angle
tw: 下滑：立刃減小

en: Ideal: slightly more on the front foot entering the turn (about 55–60%), shifting to the back foot at the exit. Toeside pressure on the forefoot, heelside on the heels. Upper body follows the board, eyes on the line, edges controlled with ankles and knees.
tw: 理想：入彎前腳稍重（約 55–60%），出彎移到後腳。前刃壓力在前腳掌，後刃在腳跟。上半身跟著板子，眼睛看行進方向，用腳踝和膝蓋控制立刃。

en: Cross the slope on the uphill edge: heel traverse facing downhill, toe traverse facing uphill. Look where you want to go.
tw: 用上坡側的刃橫越斜坡：後刃斜滑降面向下坡、前刃斜滑降面向上坡。眼睛看要去的方向。

en: Twisting the upper body to turn the board makes the tail wash out and the skid uncontrolled; upper and lower body get out of sync at the edge change and you fall easily. Turns should be driven by the lower body (ankles, knees).
tw: 用上半身扭去帶板子轉，會讓板尾甩出、搓雪失控，換刃時上下半身不同步，很容易摔。轉彎應該由下半身（腳踝、膝蓋）帶。

en: Control the edge angle with your ankles: big = stop, small = slide.
tw: 用腳踝控制立刃角度：大就停，小就滑。

en: Viewed from the tail
tw: 從板尾看

en: Straight run
tw: 直滑

en: Where should you look?
tw: 眼睛應該看哪裡？
